name: ECOSHOP
recent: Eco-Shop 在 2026 年 11 月 4 日举行第 12 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会，所有议案均获通过，包括设立新的雇员认股计划（ESOS）及委任 Deloitte 为新核数师。公司于 10 月 27 日公布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度业绩，营收按年增长 15.2% 至 RM793.68mil，净利按年增长 26.1% 至 RM63.19mil，并宣布每股 0.61 仙中期股息。近期董事及主要股东有多项股权变动，包括董事行使 ESOS 期权及在公开市场买卖股份。
notable: 第 12 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 4 日举行，所有议案均获通过，包括设立新的 ESOS 及委任 Deloitte 为新核数师。
公布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度业绩，营收 RM793.68mil，净利 RM63.19mil，并宣布每股 0.61 仙中期股息。
董事 Dato' Sri Lee Kar Whart 于 2026 年 10 月 29 日及 30 日间接增持共 8,444,000 股普通股。
risks: 董事及主要股东在近期有多项股权变动，包括行使 ESOS 期权及公开市场交易。
特别股东大会中，有关设立 ESOS 及分配期权予董事的议案，反对票比例约 46%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度，营收为 RM793.68mil，按年增长 15.2%，按季增长 2.7%；净利为 RM63.19mil，按年增长 26.1%，按季下降 13.0%；净利率为 8.0%，低于上一季度的 9.4%。

recent_en: Eco-Shop held its 12th AGM and an EGM on 4 November 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including the establishment of a new employees' share option scheme (ESOS) and the appointment of Deloitte as the new auditor. On 27 October, the company reported quarterly results for the period ended 31 August 2026, with revenue up 15.2% year-on-year to RM793.68mil and net profit up 26.1% year-on-year to RM63.19mil, declaring an interim dividend of 0.61 sen per share. There were also several changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests recently, including directors exercising ESOS options and open market purchases.
notable_en: The 12th AGM and EGM were held on 4 November 2026, with all resolutions passed, including the establishment of a new ESOS and the appointment of Deloitte as the new auditor.
Reported quarterly results for the period ended 31 August 2026, with revenue of RM793.68mil and net profit of RM63.19mil, and declared an interim dividend of 0.61 sen per share.
Director Dato' Sri Lee Kar Whart indirectly acquired a total of 8,444,000 ordinary shares on 29 and 30 October 2026.
risks_en: There were several changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests recently, including exercises of ESOS options and open market transactions.
At the EGM, resolutions relating to the establishment of the ESOS and allocation of options to directors received about 46% votes against.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM793.68mil, up 15.2% year-on-year and 2.7% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM63.19mil, up 26.1% year-on-year but down 13.0% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 8.0%, lower than 9.4% in the previous quarter.
